arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_users FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions labelled as fraud and the number of distinct users whose cards made them.
assumptions: A transaction's user is the owner of the card it was made on (transactions.card_id -> cards.user_id).
Only transactions with a fraud label of 1 are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
